scope: Synthetic narrator derived from the approved identity root through the two recorded official steps of its derivation, with only the edges trimmed so that the root's pauses stay; clearer voicing and no codebook-0 zero frame; no time-stretch, pitch shift or recast. derivation.silence_treatment: After each step, only the edges are trimmed to 0.1 s around the first and last 10 ms frame above -45 dBFS; inner quiet is kept, so the narration copies the root's thought pauses.
derivation.selection: Of the second step's seeds 55847-55861, the takes with no codebook-0 zero frame (55849, 55852, 55853, 55856, 55858, 55861) were compared; 55849 was narrated in full.

objective_comparison.clarity: Median cepstral peak prominence over frames within 18 dB of the 95th-percentile energy: identity root 16.9 dB, DDWG clear reference 7ff6347e 20.0 dB, this reference 18.6 dB; narrations: current Chinese 15.9 dB, this voice 19.1 dB on segment 01, DDWG Chinese 20.3 dB.
objective_comparison.pauses: In-take pauses at least 0.12 s and 30 dB below the take's level: 36 per minute in the current narration, 15 with the DDWG clear reference, 39 with this reference.
objective_comparison.endings: 54 of 54 first takes of the nine Chinese segments end naturally by filmkit's ending check; the current reference's first takes left 35 of 54 inside their last syllable (2026-11-03).
objective_comparison.pace: At a 0.6 s inner cap the nine segments take 781.1 s against the current 751.0 s (x1.040).

derivation.reason: The approved root is breathy, and its two codebook-0 zero frames cut every take's end under mlx-audio 0.6.4; this reference keeps the narrator's identity and pauses, is clearer and has no zero frame.
